content.text: Let me do a quick numerical check against the reference.

input.summary: Ported fir.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/fir.dp.cpp. It has no dpct headers, helpers or macros, and compiles without the dpct include path. The kernel is a 1-D nd_range with a local_accessor tile and group_barrier. The 64 taps are captured by value in the kernel lambda, replacing __constant__ memory. Error-code plumbing is gone. Errors now surface as SYCL exceptions. I ran it on a synthetic 2-channel, 20000-frame WAV and compared it with fir_ref.cpp. The maximum absolute difference was 1.2e-7, which is within atol=1e-05. I did not run the audio dBFS null test itself.
